label: At every world each existing concrete individual is absent from some possible world
paraphrase: Candidate framework commitment, unattributed (worldwise individual deletion): for every world v and every concrete individual x existing at v, some world accessible from v lacks x. Thus, at each world v, no concrete individual existing at v is necessary relative to v (world-relative necessity). This does not constrain non-concrete individuals or, without reflexivity, exclude necessity at v for a concrete individual absent at v. Individual by individual: it does not assert a world lacking all concrete individuals at once.
